A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and provide readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–L. v4 retains this material and appends a NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: v3 reports original MuJoCo experiments and LLM alignment evaluations, including results in Tables 1–3 and 5–6.

after.justification: v4 retains the original MuJoCo experiments and LLM alignment results in Tables 1–3 and 5–6.

M1.justification: TA-MPO is renamed TeMPO. Its objectives in Equations 12–13, temporal schedules, and the MPO parameterization and evolutionary search procedure remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TLA and Hopper scenarios and the same three Gemma/Mistral and preference-dataset combinations for AlpacaEval. No evaluated coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical method sets, including CPO, ORPO, DPO and SimPO in Table 2, and KTO and f-DPO (Jensen-Shannon) in Table 5.

E3.justification: Dataset sizes, training budgets, metrics, judges and tuning protocols in Sections 4–5 and Appendices I, K and L are unchanged. The checklist supplies no revised experimental settings.

E4.justification: The gradient analysis in Figure 6, temporal-schedule comparisons, SFT and gamma analyses in Table 3, and supplementary noise and bad-judge analyses in Appendix I are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Tables 1 and 5 already report averages and standard errors over 25 trained agents, and Table 2 already reports standard errors. Checklist item 7 repeats the existing reporting practice without adding run counts or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: All result entries and qualitative findings are unchanged after matching TA-MPO to TeMPO. For example, Table 2 retains schedule 3 win rates of 35.4±1.7, 39.4±1.7 and 41.6±1.7.

T1.justification: Definition 2.1, Theorem 3.1, its Appendix C proof, and the mathematical reasoning in Appendices D–G are unchanged. The checklist merely references the existing proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about the MuJoCo diagnostic suite, MPO discovery and transfer to LLM alignment. Renaming TA-MPO does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Section 5 retains its explanations involving overfitting, sparse LLM data and the learned objectives' limited logit range. Checklist item 10 adds only a generic harmful-use caveat, without a substantive new interpretation or technical limitation.

D1.justification: Implementation and dataset links, the four NVIDIA L40S GPUs, and hyperparameters in Appendices K–L remain unchanged. Checklist answers add assertions and cross-references rather than new implementation or access information.

R1.justification: The references and research positioning, including Appendix B's comparisons with DiscoPOP and f-DPO, are unchanged. Additional checklist policy links do not expand the related-work discussion.

P1.justification: v4 consistently renames TA-MPO to TeMPO, corrects Jakob N. Foester to Jakob N. Foerster, and appends a standard 16-item NeurIPS checklist. The existing prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 1 and 2 update the algorithm's row labels, nearby text reflows slightly, and checklist pages are appended. Existing figures, table structures and appendix layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: The author-name correction and consistent algorithm rename provide small editorial benefits. The appended checklist mostly repeats existing information and standard guidance, leaving the scientific evidence, explanations, theory and reproducibility details unchanged; it does not establish a meaningful overall quality improvement or decline.
